name: Closure conditioning — operating-domain and lambda-map audit
description: Separate conditioning and uniqueness audit for the production 8x8 mechanical closure and 2x2 stick-root map. Actual-root states are drawn from the nominal launch and the shared verification operating-case library; expensive lambda-plane maps are reserved for a smaller representative/worst subset.

physical.definition: exact static Coulomb-capacity intervals from the frozen contact law; physical topology admissibility is overlaid separately

expanded.definition: signed half-width max(2.5, 4x largest physical static magnitude), normally [-2.6,+2.6]; mathematical continuation with static box shown explicitly

broad.definition: signed [-10,+10] high-resolution structural diagnostic; produced only for one showcase state

interpretation_boundaries: The so-called physical map is the static Coulomb-capacity box, not automatically the mechanically admissible subset. Topology admissibility is evaluated independently.
Every grid point is computed and retained in NPZ even when the masked presentation hides it.
Expanded and broad domains are mathematical diagnostics, not claimed operating regions.

Finite-lambda walls are not assumed to be poles of the wrap functions. The regular Phi/Psi formulation has no finite real singularity; sharp finite-lambda walls must be checked against the assembled 8x8 singular values and topology diagnostics.
det(J_R) is retained as a geometric diagnostic; singular values and kappa(J_R) are the formal stick-root conditioning measures.

J_R is defined by an independent central derivative of the frozen stick residual map at the root. EngagedContactSolveResult.jacobian is solver working state and may be Broyden-updated by continuation, so it is not used as the physical conditioning reference.
